Question: As-salaam alaikum Hazrat, My questions are as follow, 1. Is it allow to chat online with na-mehram whose pic is not seen yet? 2. Wearing Burkha aur Hijab is Sunnah Wajib or Farz on Muslim Women n about covering the face? 3. Keeping beard how much is it Wajib or sunnah? 4. A person asked me that if a women will die n goes to jannah which husband she will get the husband which died or the Husband who was her last husband If a women has remarried? may be after divorce or death of her previous husband? Answer ID: 14349 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1089/1089=M/1430) (1) No. (2) A woman should observe purdah before non-mahram, she should cover her face. (3) It is wajib (necessary) to grow beard to a size of one fist. (4) Such a woman will be given option to choose to live with man she likes. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
